title: Does Technology Make Us Less Human?
main_content:
It is not unusual these days to see people eating together at restaurants, but not interacting with each other. Instead, they are looking down at their smartphones.

While some people fear what technology is doing to society and relationships, others say the ever-evolving technology is an improvement on life.

“One of the problems with technology is we often try to think about whether it is either monolithically good or bad and it’s not. It’s a tool,” said Linda Burch of Common Sense Media, an organization that guides parents and children through the world of technology.

questions.question: What are the two main views about technology mentioned in the article?
options: Technology is always harmful and should be avoided.
Technology is either completely good or completely bad.
Technology can be seen as a tool that may improve life, but some people worry it harms society and relationships.
Technology has no effect on society or relationships.
questions.answer: Technology can be seen as a tool that may improve life, but some people worry it harms society and relationships.

questions.question: What does Linda Burch say about technology?
options: It is a tool, not something that is simply all good or all bad.
It should be used only by adults.
It is mainly responsible for damaging relationships.
It has no value in everyday life.
questions.answer: It is a tool, not something that is simply all good or all bad.
